CREATE TABLE pk_in_i32 (k Int32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS index_granularity = 64
CREATE TABLE pk_in_date (k Date) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS index_granularity = 1
